formula.description: u16 LE code; bank=(v>>8)&0xFF, low=v&0xFF. bank==0: low<0x80 -> ctrl, low>=0x80 -> half-width glyph tile=low-128 (vertical 2-tile stack {tile, tile+32}, 8x16px; CONFIRMED 2026-08-11 via offline pixel scan of Font_DOM.nbfc tile index 0-31, exact match against all 20 previously hardware-confirmed half codes - old formula tile=2*low-14 was wrong). bank!=0: if v+33>=NUM_TILES(14336) -> ctrl (out of range, non-printable marker), else -> full-width glyph tile=v (2x2 tile block, 16x16px). REAL-HARDWARE CONFIRMED 2026-08-11 (temp/probe_all_half_codes_ingame.py -> melonDS, see ANALYSIS_NOTES.md): 0080 renders as a true blank (invisible); 0081-0086/0088-008B/008D/008F/0090-009F (all punctuation+digits+A-E with a char field) render exactly as predicted with zero exceptions; 00C1='G', 00CA='P', 00CC='S' also confirmed clean. 00A4/00A6/00B4/00B8/00BC (no char field, intentionally) rendered as broken/garbled fragments on real hardware, not valid characters - do not assign char to these.
